The primary source was not opened (403).

judgement.doubts: The status is progress either way: the bullet asks for the value of Λ, and both 2026 results only move the upper bound (F3). The event is switched to Raymond's bound because it is tighter on the same quantity and therefore marks the frontier; Gomila's bound is superseded numerically, although it has had more scrutiny (Romik's review is still in progress). If Raymond's bound fails, the frontier falls back to Gomila's, and the status and AI role stay the same. The AI role is 'assisted' for both bounds, but it rests on thin disclosures (F9). Neither source says which pieces of mathematics the AI produced. Gomila's 'adversarial AI review panel' is only a critic and counts for nothing. Only the 'human–AI collaboration' / 'developed with AI assistance' wording supports 'assisted'. If the sources are read strictly, the role could be 'none'.

outcome_prefix: Judged: the status rests on Raymond's 21 September 2026 Zenodo/GitHub bound Λ ≤ 0.149396, an unreviewed AI-assisted computer-assisted bound that supersedes Gomila's 0.1787854 on the same quantity.

corrections.why: F8: The disputes entry says Raymond's Λ ≤ 0.149396 is 'superseding Gomila's numerically'. Both are progress-tier bounds on the same quantity, so the tighter one is the frontier. The researcher chose Gomila as 'most substantively reviewed', but Romik's review is 'in-progress', so that bound is not digested either.
F8: These credits follow the event the status rests on. Gomila, Romik and Atkin belong to the superseded Gomila bound, which is still described in outcome and disputes.

corrections.from: This repository presents a computer-assisted proof ... developed through human–AI collaboration ... four-agent adversarial AI review panel ...
corrections.why: F8/F9: The old quote belongs to Gomila's event, and it is preserved here. Its 'adversarial AI review panel' part describes critique, which counts for nothing. The new quote is Raymond's disclosure as the record gives it. It is thin (F9), and 'assisted' is kept only on the plain reading that the AI helped produce the bound.

F3: I agree with the 2026-09-24 correction: the bullet asks for Λ's value, and only the upper bound moved. The Λ = 0 claim is set aside as not credible under F5. The only doubt is whether Raymond's fresh, unreviewed bound holds, and the status is progress even if it does not.

F9: Both bounds disclose AI assistance without saying what the AI produced. Gomila's review panel only criticised the work. Kept at 'assisted' on the 'developed with AI assistance' / 'human–AI collaboration' wording. Under a strict reading it could be 'none'.
